outside_sources.title: Scott AC, Chu FYF, McLaughlin DW (1973) The soliton: A new concept in applied science — Proc. IEEE 61(10):1443-1483
outside_sources.author: Scott AC, Chu FYF, McLaughlin DW
outside_sources.related: Survey paper that introduced soliton physics to engineering; reviews sine-Gordon equation and its exact kink, breather and two-soliton solutions

outside_sources.title: Ablowitz MJ, Kaup DJ, Newell AC, Segur H (1973) Method for Solving the Sine-Gordon Equation — Physical Review Letters 30(25):1262
outside_sources.author: Ablowitz MJ, Kaup DJ, Newell AC, Segur H
outside_sources.related: The AKNS paper: establishes the Lax pair for the sine-Gordon equation and derives all N-soliton solutions via inverse scattering

outside_sources.title: NumPy — BSD-3-Clause
outside_sources.author: NumPy contributors
outside_sources.related: Used for meshgrid, arctan, sinh, cosh, clip, outer, broadcast_to vectorised evaluation of exact solutions

physics.solver: Exact closed-form (no numerical stepping — completely integrable via Lax pair / AKNS inverse scattering)

shape_keys.Basis: Single kink v=0.65 x0=-4.0  phi_K=4 arctan[exp(gamma(x-vt-x0))] gamma=1/sqrt(1-0.65^2)=1.316
shape_keys.SK_Breather: Stationary breather omega=0.50  phi_B=4 arctan[(beta/omega) sin(omega*t)/cosh(beta*x)] beta=sqrt(1-0.25)=0.866
shape_keys.SK_Collision: Kink-antikink head-on v=0.65  phi=4 arctan[v sinh(gamma*x)/cosh(gamma*v*t)]  phase_shift=2/gamma*log(2v)
shape_keys.SK_TwoKink: Two co-propagating kinks v1=0.80 v2=0.30 x01=-7 x02=6  superposition minus 4pi offset

physics.integrability: Lax pair: Zacharov-Shabat system; infinite tower of conserved charges; Hirota tau-function gives N-soliton exact solutions; Backlund transform generates new solutions from known ones
physics.topological_charge: Q = (1/4pi) * [phi(+inf,t) - phi(-inf,t)]; kink Q=+1, antikink Q=-1, breather Q=0
physics.phase_shift_kink_antikink: Delta = (2/gamma) * log(2v)  (only trace of elastic collision)
